transcription.text: In the glow of the kitchen light, your shadow cracked like coal Syntax of a slurred command, love commented out in no more Arms are never open, only clenched into the night I like a recursion of your age, looping fear instead of love And every variable in me still carries your design Unblue printed and drunkenly across a child's mind If that else, your name of failure functioned in matches If that else, your name of failure functioned in matches The cause, the cause, the reason I can't rest I trace the logic of the herd, I drag like chains Finding every broken piece still maps back to your name You spoke in crashing arguments, exceptions thrown like rain I index the solos and all No hug, no warmth, just brittle truths You never meant to send, but I compile them anyway A child trying to comprehend Now I'm the program glitching with the ghost of what was real A system built on warnings that I never learned to heal If that else, if that else, your code runs deeper than the years between us now If that else, if that else, the trigger in my thoughts I still can't do both somehow Every checking thought I'd find every storm inside my head is just the echo of the world you wrote for me instead Still I reach for something tender in the logic of your face But memory is a labyrinth with no exit just your trace I wander through each hollow room, the echoes intertwine A paradoxal wanting love that never once was mine I can't rewrite the origin and unwind the primal color Your absence is the algorithm that feeds my every flow If that else, if that else, I am the son of all the pain you couldn't hold If that else, that else, your code became the framework in my soul Yet through the static I keep searching for a way to transcend, to break the chain of code You love to close the loop, you'll never know

segments.text: In the glow of the kitchen light, your shadow cracked like coal
Syntax of a slurred command, love commented out in no more
Arms are never open, only clenched into the night
I like a recursion of your age, looping fear instead of love
And every variable in me still carries your design
Unblue printed and drunkenly across a child's mind
If that else, your name of failure functioned in matches
If that else, your name of failure functioned in matches
The cause, the cause, the reason I can't rest
I trace the logic of the herd, I drag like chains
Finding every broken piece still maps back to your name
You spoke in crashing arguments, exceptions thrown like rain
I index the solos and all
No hug, no warmth, just brittle truths
You never meant to send, but I compile them anyway
A child trying to comprehend
Now I'm the program glitching with the ghost of what was real
A system built on warnings that I never learned to heal
If that else, if that else, your code runs deeper than the years between us now
If that else, if that else, the trigger in my thoughts I still can't do both somehow
Every checking thought I'd find every storm inside my head is just the echo of the world you wrote for me instead
Still I reach for something tender in the logic of your face
But memory is a labyrinth with no exit just your trace
I wander through each hollow room, the echoes intertwine
A paradoxal wanting love that never once was mine
I can't rewrite the origin and unwind the primal color
Your absence is the algorithm that feeds my every flow
If that else, if that else, I am the son of all the pain you couldn't hold
If that else, that else, your code became the framework in my soul
Yet through the static I keep searching for a way to transcend, to break the chain of code
You love to close the loop, you'll never know
